title: Affine locus of compatible sections on a finite closed cover
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], covered set theoretically by finitely many closed immersions i_a:C_a → X [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Let T be any subset of X. Fix an invertible module L [def-sc-invertible-module] with global section t, invertible modules P_a on C_a with sections s_a and affine opens V_a equal to their nonvanishing loci [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. Suppose i_a^{-1}(T) lies in the locus of s_a. Suppose there are isomorphisms i_a^*L ≅ P_a carrying the adjunction-unit restriction of t to s_a [def-pc-module-pullback] [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. Then there is a section q of L^1 and an affine open U containing T whose underlying set is its nonvanishing locus. No reducedness, ampleness, finiteness of T or gluing conclusion is assumed.

source.place: Lemma 09NX, second paragraph, affine glued section locus; Limits Lemma 09NL and Properties Section 01PR

proof.text: Apply nonvanishing_section_trivializes to the fixed L,t, obtaining its open locus U.

Apply the existing nonvanishing_tensorPullback theorem to identify the nonvanishing of the adjunction-unit restriction of t with that of t. The component isomorphism preserves nonvanishing, and section compatibility identifies this locus with V_a. The cover and containment hypothesis now put T inside U.

The morphismRestrict of every closed immersion to U is still a closed immersion. Its source is (i_a^{-1}U).toScheme = (V_a).toScheme, affine by hypothesis. Lift a point of U through hcover, obtaining the explicit finite closed cover required by isAffine_of_finite_closed_cover. That theorem makes U affine. This covers r=0 as well.
Use the right unitor L.tensorPow 1 ≅ L and its inverse to transport t. The stalk-isomorphism argument preserves the locus U, giving q and the required witnesses.

theorem affine_locus_of_compatible_component_sections
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (r : ℕ) (C : Fin r → Scheme.{u})
    (i : ∀ a, C a ⟶ X) [∀ a, IsClosedImmersion (i a)]
    (hcover : (⋃ a, Set.range (i a)) = Set.univ) (T : Set X)
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible] (t : Γ(L, ⊤))
    (P : ∀ a, (C a).Modules) [∀ a, (P a).IsInvertible]
    (s : ∀ a, Γ(P a, ⊤)) (V : ∀ a, (C a).Opens)
    (hTV : ∀ a, i a ⁻¹' T ⊆ nonvanishingLocus (P a) (s a))
    (hVlocus : ∀ a, (V a : Set (C a)) = nonvanishingLocus (P a) (s a))
    (hVaff : ∀ a, IsAffineOpen (V a))
    (he : ∀ a, ∃ e : (tensorPullback (i a)).obj L ≅ P a,
      e.hom.val.app (op ⊤)
        (((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (i a))).unit.app L).val.app
          (op ⊤) t) = s a) :
    ∃ (q : (L.tensorPow 1).val.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) (U : X.Opens),
      T ⊆ (U : Set X) ∧ IsAffineOpen U ∧
        (U : Set X) = nonvanishingLocus (L.tensorPow 1) q
